summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a consulting services agreement between its robotics division FF AI-Robotics and AIBOT Inc. for FCC compliance support at $25,000 per month for 12 months. AIBOT is related through executives with overlapping roles; the Audit Committee approved the terms under the related-party policy. This is a routine service contract with details on fees and term, but not a special situation such as M&A or restructuring.
